sentences.en: In his autobiography, he repeatedly refers to his unhappy school days.
sentences.zh: 在他的自传中，他反复提到了自己不愉快的学校时光。

sentences.en: His autobiography was released today and was sold out by noon.
sentences.zh: 他的自传今天发布，上午十二点就被抢购一空。

sentences.en: When I feel like writing an autobiography, I will.
sentences.zh: 等我感觉想写自传的时候再说吧。
